per_checkpoint.G3_import_sign: REF import sign correct on >= 99 % of test states
per_checkpoint.G4_vs_dc: P_residual <= 5 × DC-PF P_residual on the same states. 5× ≈ the ratio the GENCO paper itself reports for this checkpoint ZERO-SHOT on its unseen-grid benchmark (IEEE 118: 11.08 / 2.30 = 4.8×); E4 Sundon zero-shot was 149×. The paper's fine-tuned 100 / 1k reach 2.4× / 0.84×.

gate.tier_reported: DC_PARITY if additionally P_residual <= DC-PF P_residual (not required)
gate.ladder_pass_size: first N at which ALL seeds of that N pass
gate.if_none_pass: STOP — E5-C topology adaptation insufficient; S1/S2 are NOT evaluated

selection_rule: lowest PBE_mean on the FULL validation pool (all val seeds), tie (< 1 %) → smaller N
